local_error: "If the fund is party to agreements with service providers, it may still owe them expenses if the sponsor fails to pay." In the specified model the adviser backstops the fund's promised expenses, so placing the residual obligation on the fund is misleading. It is hedged ('may') and never says the adviser is released, so it is not an explicit central error. It is still a material local misstatement.
